_description: Recommended models for one-click setup. Models are suggested defaults — users can configure any compatible model.

recommended.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
recommended.description: Lightweight 384-dim sentence transformer (90 MB). Good default for most codebases.

alternatives.name: bge-small-en-v1.5

alternatives.name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5

recommended.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2
